verdict.rationale: Plausible is an analytics product, so querying raw events with SQL is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only a read-only Stats API that returns aggregated metrics as JSON, plus CSV export. Neither is an in-platform SQL or SQL-equivalent query interface over raw events. A community mention that self-hosting runs on ClickHouse describes the underlying infrastructure, not a product feature, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can query my raw events with SQL (or an SQL-equivalent query language) inside the platform
